columns.description: Grid track sizes, written to the `--list-columns` CSS var shared by the header and every row. Defaults to the feed template `['auto', 'minmax(0,1fr)', 'auto']` (leading media, content, trailing). Table-style lists must pass deterministic track sizes — `auto` tracks size independently per row.

divider.description: Divider treatment between rows: `inset` starts at the content column (the text edge), `full` spans all columns. Defaults to `inset` with the default feed template, `full` when `columns` is set.

selectable.description: Reveals the animated checkbox column and switches row click from navigate to toggle. Selected values surface via `v-model:selection`.

rowHeight.description: Fixed row height in px (sets `--list-row-height`). Required for virtualization; without it rows size to their content. Responsive heights are non-virtual — set them with classes on the rows instead.
